question:
Identify the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Freezing
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Freezing"** means extremely cold temperatures, often associated with ice or frost. (जमने योग्य ठंडा)

 
 
• **Example: **The water in the lake was **freezing**, making it impossible to swim.
 
 
 
• **"Tropical"** refers to regions that are warm and humid, typically found near the equator. (उष्णकटिबंधीय)
 
 
• **Example: **The** tropical** climate of the island attracts tourists all year round.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Freezing'** is **'Tropical'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Summery** (गर्मियों जैसा): Characteristic of or suitable for summer.

 
 
• **Example:** She wore a **summery **dress to the picnic.
 
 
 
• **Brisk** (तेज): Active and energetic.
 
 
• **Example:** They took a **brisk** walk in the park.
 
 
 
• **Gnawing** (कुतरने वाला): Persistently worrying or distressing.
 
 
• **Example : **you could hear it **gnawing **at a bone.

The correct answer is **Option 4)**
